$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor validation and autocomplete.

defaultMode.description: Default permission mode. Agent Permission Policy modes: standard, autonomous, restricted, readonly. Claude Code compatible modes: plan, dontAsk, acceptEdits, bypassPermissions, default.

ceiling.description: Marks this layer as a ceiling: the allow rules of deeper layers only take effect where this layer also allows. Deeper layers can still add deny and ask rules, and cannot loosen the default mode.

activeProfile.description: Name of the active profile from `profiles`. If unset, use the top-level permission tiers directly.

allow.description: Tools auto-approved without prompting. Evaluated after deny rules.

deny.description: Tools always denied — short-circuits before allow and ask. A deny cannot be overridden by an allow in any other source.

ask.description: Tools that always prompt, even in autonomous mode. Evaluated after deny but before allow.

additionalDirectories.description: Directories beyond project root that agents may access.

defaultMode.description: Default permission mode. Accepted here for Claude Code compatibility, or at the top level for the canonical placement.

permissions.description: Tool permission rules — evaluated in deny → ask → allow order.

pattern.description: Pattern to match against tool input. When absent, matches any input.

tier.description: Permission tier to apply when this rule matches.

approvers.description: On an ask rule: the roles and actors who may approve the request, and how long it may wait. An unresolved request expires as a deny.

roles.description: Roles whose holders may approve the request.

actors.description: Actors who may approve the request. The requester is never one of them.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the request may stay unresolved. An unresolved request expires as a deny.

hidden.description: On a deny rule: also leave the tool out of the agent's tool list. The call is refused as a plain deny is. Only a rule with no pattern hides the whole tool.

when.description: Optional conditions. All must match for the rule to apply (AND logic).

env.description: Environment variables that must each equal the given value (AND logic).

actor.description: Actor pattern (glob): who is making the call, as the host reports it. Unknown when the host reports none.

role.description: Role pattern (glob): holds when the actor has a matching role, as the host reports the roles. Unknown when the host reports none.

remote.description: Git remote pattern (glob), matched against the origin as host/path in lower case, so git@github.com:Org/Repo.git and https://github.com/org/repo both match github.com/org/*.

predicate.description: A trilean predicate tree over the context. Reference keys name context fields: cwd, branch, actor, remote, env:NAME and role:NAME. An unknown field makes the result unknown, which restricts and never grants. Nodes that would read an unknown field as absent or empty (exists, some, every, fold) are not allowed.

items.description: Permission rule. Evaluated deny-first: all deny rules, then ask, then allow.

rules.description: Permission rules. Evaluated deny-first: all deny rules checked, then ask, then allow. Falls back to defaultMode when no rule matches.

allow.description: Tools auto-approved without prompting. Evaluated after deny rules.

deny.description: Tools always denied — short-circuits before allow and ask. A deny cannot be overridden by an allow in any other source.

ask.description: Tools that always prompt, even in autonomous mode. Evaluated after deny but before allow.

roles.description: Permission tiers by role. Each rule applies to actors holding the role, as if it carried `when: { role }`.

allow.description: Tools auto-approved without prompting. Evaluated after deny rules.

deny.description: Tools always denied — short-circuits before allow and ask. A deny cannot be overridden by an allow in any other source.

ask.description: Tools that always prompt, even in autonomous mode. Evaluated after deny but before allow.

additionalDirectories.description: Directories beyond project root that agents may access.

defaultMode.description: Default permission mode. Accepted here for Claude Code compatibility, or at the top level for the canonical placement.

extends.description: Names of profiles this one extends. Their rules come first, then this profile's own; extending only adds.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of agent nesting. 0 = no subagents allowed.

nonDelegable.description: Tools that cannot be delegated to subagents. Uses the same rule syntax.

bubbleUp.description: Whether subagents can request elevated permissions from their parent.

allow.description: Tools auto-approved without prompting. Evaluated after deny rules.

deny.description: Tools always denied — short-circuits before allow and ask. A deny cannot be overridden by an allow in any other source.

ask.description: Tools that always prompt, even in autonomous mode. Evaluated after deny but before allow.

additionalDirectories.description: Directories beyond project root that agents may access.

defaultMode.description: Default permission mode. Accepted here for Claude Code compatibility, or at the top level for the canonical placement.

agents.description: Per-agent permission overrides. Keys are agent names or glob patterns. Values replace (not merge with) the parent policy for that agent.

delegation.description: Agent delegation controls — what subagents may do.

writableRoots.description: Additional paths the agent may write to (beyond project root). Only meaningful when mode is `workspace-write`.

networkAccess.description: Whether the agent may make network requests from within the sandbox. When false, network access is blocked at the OS level.

enabled.description: Whether network access is permitted at all. When false, WebFetch and WebSearch are denied regardless of allow rules.

domains.description: Domain-level allow/deny rules for HTTP(S) requests. Supplements the WebFetch(domain:...) permission rules.

env.description: Environment variables injected into all agent sessions.

with.description: Agent configs to include when loading. Only these native configs are read (plus canonical). Mutually exclusive with `without`.

without.description: Agent configs to exclude when loading. Mutually exclusive with `with`.

up.description: How far to walk up the directory tree when loading configs. 'all' walks to the filesystem root. A number limits parent directories (0 = cwd only).

mode.description: Sync mode. 'sync' = one-shot at startup. 'watch' = continuous via fs.watch. false = disabled.

sync.description: Sync configuration for the MCP server and CLI sync command.

title: Agent Permission Policy
description: Cross-agent permission policy for AI coding agents. Defines what tools agents may use, under what conditions, and how subagents are constrained. The `with`/`without`/`up` fields control which native agent configs are discovered and merged during walk-up loading. Placed at .agents/permissions.json (team, committed) or .agents/permissions.local.json (personal, gitignored).
